Hi all — I've pulled the ledger and payment batch. Payment BR-98321 did post and has been applied to INV-4591 for the net amount. However, because the original invoice used the reverse-charge VAT indicator, our AP system routed the VAT portion to a tax clearing account rather than posting VAT as output VAT. That is why Brightbyte sees a mismatch on your side.

Two remediation paths:
1) Issue a credit note (CN-0023) for INV-4591 and reissue INV-4591 as INV-4591-R1 with the correct VAT lines (we can set the invoice to show the VAT amount explicitly so you can claim the input VAT). This is the cleanest for your auditors but requires issuing a credit + new invoice.
2) Provide a signed VAT reclassification memo from Redwood's tax team that explains the bookkeeping treatment and reconciles the applied payment to the original invoice. This is faster but acceptance depends on Brightbyte's auditor.

We've prepared both artifacts for your review: vat_reclassification_memo.pdf (explains the clearing entry) and credit_note_CN-0023.pdf (draft credit note). Please confirm which option you prefer. If you want Option 1, we'll reissue INV-4591-R1 and send a remittance confirmation once the reissue is posted.
